source: User-reported physical Windows/TV test and supplied host diagnostics

observations: The last 700 Gateway events contain 176 GET /api/v1/capabilities HTTP 403 responses for two child profiles.

The same recent events contain four successful control/operation/acquire and four successful control/operation/complete requests for the parent profile, proving the S05 host control routes are deployed.
After child selection there is no child session start/status/end or game/start request in this observed sequence.

results.evidence: Resident Evil 3 launches the overlay from a grey tile. Outside allowed hours a schedule denial is shown; inside allowed hours launch remains at host readiness confirmation.
Child game launch never completes and eventually reports Gateway unavailable; full quit itself was not exercised.

diagnosis.cause: S05 preflight requires control_operations_v1 negotiation, but the child GET route allowlist rejected /api/v1/capabilities before reaching the adult capabilities handler.
diagnosis.retry: ConsoleActivity.createHostLaunchPreflight.profile calls getCapabilities; HostLaunchPreflight.awaitGatewayProfile retries IOException every 1000 ms for up to 90000 ms.
diagnosis.fix: Authorize capabilities through the existing child capability and use_profile gates; expose only child_profiles_v1/control_operations_v1 and Gateway online/API metadata, without parent health probes or privileged integration data.
diagnosis.ownership: GatewayState remains the capabilities projection owner; GatewayHandler retains authentication and routing. Shared protocol flags have one definition for both actor projections. Existing child policy and effect-time fencing remain authoritative. No new state or effect owner is introduced.

local_validation.targeted_before_fix: 2 tests, 1 failure: expected HTTP 200 but received 403
local_validation.child_http_result: 16 tests PASS in 0.383 seconds; includes capabilities -> child-only profile projection -> eligibility -> session start -> control permit/game start -> terminal end/replay, and control/game start denial after successful negotiation without a child session
local_validation.cumulative_result: 215 tests PASS in 16.147 seconds on the final test candidate
